title: SBI Overtakes TCS as India's 4th Most Valuable Company
summary: SBI market capitalization crosses ₹10.9 lakh crore, surpassing TCS to become India's 4th most valuable company by m-cap.

blocks.content: State Bank of India's m-cap crossed **₹10.9 lakh crore**, pushing past TCS (~₹10.5 lakh crore) to become India's **4th most valuable listed company**.

items: **Top M-Cap Hierarchy**: Reliance (~₹19.8L Cr) > HDFC Bank (~₹14.3L Cr) > Bharti Airtel (~₹12.1L Cr) > SBI (>₹10.9L Cr).
